purpose_ko: 중요 미션 종료 시 Cursor가 채팅에 붙여넣는 검증 꾸러미 포맷을 고정한다. 작업자 보고(CURSOR_REPORTED)와 원격 직접확인(VERIFIED)을 분리한다. 전용 builder 스크립트는 본 버전 비범위.

epistemic_labels.CURSOR_REPORTED: Cursor/worker stated state; ChatGPT has not directly inspected internal source
epistemic_labels.VERIFIED: ChatGPT (or commander remote validator) inspected GitHub mirror, uploaded artifact, or otherwise directly readable source

paste_template:
MISSION=<mission_id>
LANE=<lane>
EPISTEMIC=CURSOR_REPORTED | VERIFIED

branch=<branch>
base_sha=<optional>
result_sha=<sha>

changed_files=<files>

checker=<command/result | none>
pytest=<result | none>
build=<result | none>

receipt=<path>
receipt.result=<state>

artifact_hash=<optional sha256>

github_push=HOLD | PUSHED_WITH_ACK
pass_ceiling=<ceiling>

known_issues=<optional>
NEXT=STOP | <next_candidate_ack>
AUTO_NEXT=false

judgment_rules.rule: Default epistemic label after Cursor paste is CURSOR_REPORTED.
VERIFIED only after direct source check (GitHub mirror / uploaded artifact / readable source).
PASS_STRUCTURAL_CONTRACT means contract structure only; not runtime, effectiveness, or product DONE.
AUTO_NEXT=false at important mission end unless separate commander ACK.
Dedicated verification-bundle builder script deferred until format stabilizes.
